groups.title: Black Silhouettes
groups.theme: Flat black animals and figures on one bright color, ringed with short wavy lines.

groups.title: Beams and Glowing Eyes
groups.theme: Heads and creatures lit from inside: light pours out of eyes and across the square in broad yellow beams.

groups.title: Framed Heads, First Masks
groups.theme: A single head packed edge to edge inside a drawn border, with teeth, X eyes and target eyes; the start of the masks.

groups.title: Line Figures and Crowds
groups.theme: Figures drawn as lines and tangles: neon outlines on dark grounds, rows of tall figures, crowds packed into one weave.

groups.title: Skeletons and Monsters
groups.theme: Bony stick figures dancing and walking on flat color, beside hunched, fanged creatures in the dark.

groups.title: Painted Figures, Places and Color Fields
groups.theme: Soft, blended paint: blurred figures, skies and landscapes, a few creatures, and a run of pure color fields.
